title: Prove selected4470 scoped owned-query and whole-IDLE charging
body:
## Summary

```text
owned clear/COPY -> one whole rank-f child -> tensor translation -> ADD -> owned ERASE
IDLE(S) -> one whole rank-(8|S|f) child per owner/port
```

Prove the scoped all-width charging implication and bind all 15 thin-query and 15 IDLE sites in selected4470 to unique paid jobs and explicit nonrecursive records. The retained physical ABIs remain hypotheses; no new κ is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR4951 left the local operation-to-charge correspondence open; PR4440 supplied the abstract one-column protocol and finite record allowance.
- **After:** independent exact symbolic replay at widths 1–3, all 112 actual port phase charts, the complete 30-site map and 31 semantic/source controls pass normally and under `-O` (registered replay: 0.40s). The existing 1,680 thin-query and 3,360 whole-IDLE jobs are preserved.
- Package metadata, committed bytes, source history and Git-free normal/optimized export replay pass. Full native, root and compiler replays were outside this scope.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

New isolated package only. Logical record accounting does not discharge the inherited owned-stream, all-column, fixed-tape, precision or global compiler allocation contracts.
